stem: Which sentence from the selection best expresses the controlling idea?

options.label: A
options.text: While tastes are developed at a young age, they can be altered. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: This information suggests that parents should introduce new foods to babies during this stage. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: We learn to like or dislike flavors in three main ways. (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: Children copy what they see adults eating and often learn to like vegetables. (paragraph 8)
